nodes.label: graphify Reference: Incremental Update and Cluster-Only
--update Incremental Re-extraction (build_merge)
nodes.rationale: Re-extracts only changed files to save tokens. Code-only changes skip the LLM entirely. build_merge reads graph.json directly (no NetworkX round-trip) so edge direction is preserved (#801); changed files are handled by replace-on-re-extract, so prune_sources is ONLY for genuinely deleted files (pruning changed files would delete re-extracted content, #1178). root= relativizes prune paths to match the graph's relative source_file values (#1361); without it stale nodes accumulate. directed= must be passed to --update or reciprocal A<->B edges silently collapse (#1392). A graph_diff against the pre-merge .graphify_old.json backup shows what changed.

nodes.label: --cluster-only Re-clustering
nodes.rationale: Self-contained: re-clusters, names communities, and regenerates GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.json, and graph.html from the existing graph. Must NOT re-run Steps 5-9, which read intermediate files (extract/detect/analysis) that Step 9 cleanup already deleted (#1392).
